_comment: Playable races (simplified 5e traits that matter in play). Traits with a 'rule' tag are used by the game's systems; text is for the player. standing: how some peoples tend to regard this race (used from M5/M6).

human.name: Human
human.description: The most numerous people of the realm: farmers, soldiers, priests and kings. Short-lived, ambitious and quarrelsome, humans rule most of the land and most of its troubles.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Long-lived and few, keeping to deep forests and old halls. Many humans think them proud and uncanny; many elves think humans are a plague that learned to build.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic cannot put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You rest in a waking trance: four hours count as a full night's sleep.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Stubborn, long-memoried folk of the mountain holds. They trade iron and grudges with equal care, and outlive three generations of the humans who cheat them.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.text: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage. Your gut shrugs off some of the rot that kills others.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: You read stonework like a book: double proficiency when judging masonry and underground ways.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.text: Heavy armour does not slow you.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small, quick and practical people of the farm country, easily overlooked and glad of it. They survive what kills bigger folk by being somewhere else when it arrives.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.text: When you roll a natural 1 on an attack, check or save, you may roll again.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: You can slip past anyone larger than you.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can hide behind someone bigger than you.

half_orc.name: Half-Orc
half_orc.description: Born between two peoples and trusted by neither. Strong and hard to kill, half-orcs find work as soldiers, labourers and enforcers, and are blamed first when things go missing.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: Once per long rest, when you would fall to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.text: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one extra weapon die.
